name: Éditeur
description: Opens a .env or a config file in a tab for you to fill in or check, so that an agent that needs a secret goes on without ever seeing it.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Reads and changes text files of the workspace, .env and other hidden files included, and tells the agent that asked which keys were set, never their values.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace folder: .env, config/app.yaml. A dotenv file opens as a form, any other text file in an editor. Without it the tab offers a file picker.

keys.description: For a dotenv file, the keys you need filled in, separated by commas: API_KEY,DB_URL. Shown first and marked missing.

why.description: One sentence, shown at the top of the tab: what the value is for, and where the person finds it.

line.description: For a text file, the line to jump to.
